name: Route GitHub Agent Decisions
tagline: Route bounty, repository-agent, failed-CI, flake, and MCP drift decisions to evidence-backed checks
description: Task-first router for six paid, read-only BountyVerdict decisions: check or rank public GitHub bounties, audit a repository's coding-agent instructions, diagnose a failed GitHub Actions run, decide whether to retry once or fix, and gate MCP tools/list schema changes. The skill contains no credentials and requires a valid unsigned selection preview before any explicitly authorized Base USDC payment.

install.notes: Connects to the hosted BountyVerdict MCP. A wallet is only needed after a valid unsigned preview and explicit authorization for the displayed price.
